model.name: actionBar.defaultsNewTab
model.description: The A1 default actions Scenario and Edit always open in a NEW TAB from every surface the universalActionBar composes on, never navigating the current tab. window.open _blank triggered SYNCHRONOUSLY in the tap handler (iOS: open the tab first, then point it, for any async-resolve branch — a non-sync open is silently popup-blocked). Sibling to actionBar.openBaseUnit (R36.5).
